tokens.name: layout.primary

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts are stored or specified as destination assets.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: Color roles are analytical; preview colors are original and non-exact.
tokens.role: Light and glow guide focus without becoming a general effect.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.notes: Behavioral priority must be revalidated in the destination product.
tokens.role: Short statements keep the pace closer to a product demo than a brochure.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Dark product narrative with cropped interface evidence and one restrained luminous focus. Use real product evidence beside its supporting claim.
